newsitem.title: USA: Pogo Producing stake raised by Cooperman.
newsitem.headline: Pogo Producing stake raised by Cooperman.

text.p: Investor Leon Cooperman said Tuesday he raised his stake in Pogo Producing Co to 2,151,631 common shares or 6.5 percent from 5.4 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Cooperman said his latest transactions include the purchase, through companies he controls, 400,000 additional shares on February 7 at a price of $36.75 per share.
Cooperman manages several investment partnerships, including Omega Capital Partners LP. The stake in Pogo is held for investment purposes.
Pogo, based in Houston, Texas, is engaged in exploration, development and production of oil and gas.
